pageProps.title: Menbuku Noodle Workshop Dongtan Central Park Branch
pageProps.review: Dongtan Central Park Menbuku Noodle Workshop is a Japanese udon specialty restaurant where you can taste Bukkake Udon and Zaru Udon with a chewy noodle texture.
pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Bukkake Udon", "rating": 4 } --- The texture was good and the sauce had a great umami flavor. ``` ```menu { "title": "Zaru Udon", "rating": 4 } --- A different feeling from Zaru Soba. ``` ## Review A place I found because I wanted to eat a somewhat special udon. The texture of the udon noodles is alive. It's a place worth visiting if you want the texture of chewy udon noodles. The tempura received as a service was also not greasy and delicious. ## Pictures
